panels.title: Top 5 Slowest Pages
panels.description: Average effective page load time per page URL (last period)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  page_url AS "Page URL",
  count() AS "Loads",
  round(avg(effective_page_time_ms)) AS "Avg Load Time (ms)"
FROM salesforceProd.lightning_page_view_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND effective_page_time_ms > 0
GROUP BY page_url
ORDER BY "Avg Load Time (ms)" DESC
LIMIT 5

panels.title: Top 5 Slowest Apex Classes
panels.description: Average run time per Apex entry point

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  entry_point AS "Entry Point",
  count() AS "Executions",
  round(avg(run_time_ns)) AS "Avg Run Time (ms)"
FROM salesforceProd.apex_execution_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND run_time_ns > 0
  AND entry_point != ''
GROUP BY entry_point
ORDER BY "Avg Run Time (ms)" DESC
LIMIT 5

panels.title: Top 5 Slowest REST API Resources
panels.description: Average run time per REST API resource

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  uri AS "URI",
  count() AS "Calls",
  round(avg(run_time_ns)) AS "Avg Run Time (ms)"
FROM salesforceProd.rest_api_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND run_time_ns > 0
GROUP BY uri
ORDER BY "Avg Run Time (ms)" DESC
LIMIT 5
SELECT count() FROM salesforceProd.login_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND login_status != 'LOGIN_NO_ERROR'
SELECT count() FROM salesforceProd.login_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
SELECT count() FROM salesforceProd.api_total_usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND status_code >= 400 AND counts_against_api_limit = 1
SELECT countIf(counts_against_api_limit = 1) AS "Billable API Calls" FROM salesforceProd.api_total_usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
SELECT count() FROM salesforceProd.apex_callout_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND status_code >= 400
SELECT count() FROM salesforceProd.apex_callout_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
SELECT count() FROM salesforceProd.apex_exception_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
SELECT count() FROM salesforceProd.apex_execution_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
SELECT sum(error_count) FROM salesforceProd.flow_nav_metric_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
SELECT count() FROM salesforceProd.flow_nav_metric_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
SELECT count() FROM salesforceProd.lightning_page_view_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND effective_page_time_ms > 10000
SELECT count() FROM salesforceProd.lightning_page_view_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

panels.title: Page Load Time — Avg & P95
panels.description: Average and 95th percentile effective page load time over time

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time,
  round(avg(effective_page_time_ms)) AS "Avg",
  round(quantile(0.95)(effective_page_time_ms)) AS "P95"
FROM salesforceProd.lightning_page_view_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND effective_page_time_ms > 0
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Page Loads Over Time
panels.description: Total page loads and pages exceeding 10s threshold

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time,
  count() AS "Total Loads",
  countIf(effective_page_time_ms > 10000) AS "Slow (>10s)"
FROM salesforceProd.lightning_page_view_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT app_name AS "App", count() AS "Loads"
FROM salesforceProd.lightning_page_view_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND app_name != ''
GROUP BY app_name
ORDER BY "Loads" DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT browser_name AS "Browser", count() AS "Loads"
FROM salesforceProd.lightning_page_view_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND browser_name != ''
GROUP BY browser_name
ORDER BY "Loads" DESC

SELECT device_platform AS "Device", count() AS "Loads"
FROM salesforceProd.lightning_page_view_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND device_platform != ''
GROUP BY device_platform
ORDER BY "Loads" DESC

SELECT
  $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time,
  count() AS "Executions"
FROM salesforceProd.apex_execution_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time,
  count() AS "Errors"
FROM salesforceProd.apex_exception_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time,
  round(avg(run_time_ns)) AS "Avg",
  round(quantile(0.95)(run_time_ns)) AS "P95"
FROM salesforceProd.apex_execution_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND run_time_ns > 0
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  timestamp AS "Time",
  dictGetOrDefault('salesforceProd.user_lookup', 'username', user_id, user_name) AS "User",
  class_name AS "Class",
  method_name AS "Method",
  exception_type AS "Exception",
  exception_message AS "Message"
FROM salesforceProd.apex_exception_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.title: API Calls Over Time by Family (Billable)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time,
  api_family AS "API Family",
  count() AS "Calls"
FROM salesforceProd.api_total_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND api_family != '' AND counts_against_api_limit = 1
GROUP BY time, api_family
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time,
  round(countIf(status_code >= 400) / count(), 4) AS "Error Rate"
FROM salesforceProd.api_total_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(connected_app_name, ''), NULLIF(connected_app_id, ''), NULLIF(client_name, ''), '(unknown)') AS "App / Client",
  user_name AS "User",
  count() AS "Total Calls",
  countIf(counts_against_api_limit = 1) AS "Billable Calls",
  countIf(status_code >= 400) AS "Errors",
  round(100 * countIf(status_code >= 400) / count(), 1) AS "Error %"
FROM salesforceProd.api_total_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY "App / Client", user_name
ORDER BY "Billable Calls" DESC
LIMIT 25

panels.title: Top API Resources by Error Count

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  api_resource AS "Resource",
  count() AS "Calls",
  countIf(status_code >= 400) AS "Errors",
  round(100 * countIf(status_code >= 400) / count(), 1) AS "Error %"
FROM salesforceProd.api_total_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND api_resource != ''
GROUP BY api_resource
ORDER BY "Errors" DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT
  $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time,
  count() AS "Executions",
  sum(error_count) AS "Errors"
FROM salesforceProd.flow_nav_metric_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  flow_version_id AS "Flow Version",
  count() AS "Runs",
  sum(error_count) AS "Errors",
  round(avg(total_execution_time_ms)) AS "Avg Execution Time (ms)"
FROM salesforceProd.flow_nav_metric_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY flow_version_id
ORDER BY "Avg Execution Time (ms)" DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT multiIf(exception_message LIKE '%CPU time limit%', 'CPU Timeout', exception_message LIKE '%Too many DML statements%', 'DML Limit', exception_message LIKE '%Too many query rows%', 'Too Many Rows', exception_message LIKE '%UNABLE_TO_LOCK_ROW%' OR exception_message LIKE '%unable to obtain exclusive%', 'Row Lock', exception_message LIKE '%Too many SOQL queries%', 'SOQL Limit', exception_message LIKE '%CalloutException%' OR exception_message LIKE '%timed out%', 'Callout Timeout', exception_message LIKE '%heap size%', 'Heap Limit', exception_message LIKE '%LimitException%', 'Other Limit', 'Other') AS "Category", count() AS "Count" FROM salesforceProd.apex_exception_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY "Category" ORDER BY "Count" DESC

SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time, multiIf(exception_message LIKE '%CPU time limit%', 'CPU Timeout', exception_message LIKE '%Too many DML statements%', 'DML Limit', exception_message LIKE '%Too many query rows%', 'Too Many Rows', exception_message LIKE '%UNABLE_TO_LOCK_ROW%' OR exception_message LIKE '%unable to obtain exclusive%', 'Row Lock', exception_message LIKE '%Too many SOQL queries%', 'SOQL Limit', exception_message LIKE '%CalloutException%' OR exception_message LIKE '%timed out%', 'Callout Timeout', exception_message LIKE '%heap size%', 'Heap Limit', exception_message LIKE '%LimitException%', 'Other Limit', 'Other') AS category, count() AS cnt FROM salesforceProd.apex_exception_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY time, category ORDER BY time

panels.title: Slow Executions with Exceptions (REQUEST_ID join)
panels.description: Apex executions cross-joined with exceptions via REQUEST_ID + day

targets.rawSql: SELECT e.timestamp AS "Time", dictGetOrDefault('salesforceProd.user_lookup', 'username', e.user_id, e.user_name) AS "User", e.entry_point AS "Entry Point", e.run_time_ns AS "Run Time (ms)", ex.exception_type AS "Exception Type", left(ex.exception_message, 120) AS "Message" FROM salesforceProd.apex_execution_events e INNER JOIN salesforceProd.apex_exception_events ex ON e.request_id = ex.request_id AND toDate(e.timestamp) = toDate(ex.timestamp) WHERE $__timeFilter(e.timestamp) ORDER BY e.run_time_ns DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Hours of Excess Page Load Time (>3s threshold)
panels.description: Total time users spent waiting beyond the 3s acceptable threshold

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(sum(greatest(effective_page_time_ms - 3000, 0)) / 1000.0 / 3600.0, 1) AS n FROM salesforceProd.lightning_page_view_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND effective_page_time_ms > 3000

panels.title: Distinct Users Hit by Slow Pages (>3s)

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniq(user_id) AS n FROM salesforceProd.lightning_page_view_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND effective_page_time_ms > 3000

panels.title: Avg Excess Wait per Affected User

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(sum(greatest(effective_page_time_ms - 3000, 0)) / uniq(user_id)) AS n FROM salesforceProd.lightning_page_view_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND effective_page_time_ms > 3000

panels.title: Contention Leaders — Limit Violation Breakdown
panels.description: 8 Salesforce governor limit violation types. High counts indicate org stress.

targets.rawSql: SELECT multiIf(exception_message LIKE '%CPU time limit%', 'CPU Timeout', exception_message LIKE '%Too many DML statements%', 'DML Limit', exception_message LIKE '%Too many query rows%', 'Too Many Rows', exception_message LIKE '%UNABLE_TO_LOCK_ROW%' OR exception_message LIKE '%unable to obtain exclusive%', 'Row Lock', exception_message LIKE '%Too many SOQL queries%', 'SOQL Limit', exception_message LIKE '%CalloutException%' OR exception_message LIKE '%timed out%', 'Callout Timeout', exception_message LIKE '%heap size%', 'Heap Limit', exception_message LIKE '%LimitException%', 'Other Limit', NULL) AS "Contention Type", count() AS "Count" FROM salesforceProd.apex_exception_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND "Contention Type" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "Contention Type" ORDER BY "Count" DESC

panels.title: Contention Score Over Time
panels.description: Sum of all governor limit violations per time period — rising trend = org under stress

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time, countIf(exception_message LIKE '%CPU time limit%' OR exception_message LIKE '%Too many DML statements%' OR exception_message LIKE '%Too many query rows%' OR exception_message LIKE '%UNABLE_TO_LOCK_ROW%' OR exception_message LIKE '%Too many SOQL queries%' OR exception_message LIKE '%CalloutException%' OR exception_message LIKE '%heap size%' OR exception_message LIKE '%LimitException%') AS "Contention Score" FROM salesforceProd.apex_exception_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Page Load Time vs 30-Day Baseline
panels.description: Current avg page load vs the 30-day rolling average. Divergence signals regression.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time, round(avg(effective_page_time_ms)) AS "Current Avg", (SELECT round(avg(effective_page_time_ms)) FROM salesforceProd.lightning_page_view_events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND effective_page_time_ms > 0) AS "30-day Avg" FROM salesforceProd.lightning_page_view_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND effective_page_time_ms > 0 GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time, round(avg(run_time_ns)) AS "Current Avg", (SELECT round(avg(run_time_ns)) FROM salesforceProd.apex_execution_events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND run_time_ns > 0) AS "30-day Avg" FROM salesforceProd.apex_execution_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND run_time_ns > 0 GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time, round(countIf(status_code >= 400) / count(), 4) AS "Current Error Rate", (SELECT round(countIf(status_code >= 400) / count(), 4) FROM salesforceProd.api_total_usage_events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AS "30-day Avg" FROM salesforceProd.api_total_usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: API Calls vs 800K Daily Limit (Rolling 24h)
panels.description: Total API calls counting toward Salesforce's 800K rolling 24h limit

targets.rawSql:
SELECT countIf(counts_against_api_limit = 1) AS "Billable Calls (Last 24h)"
FROM salesforceProd.api_total_usage_events
WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR

panels.title: Billable vs Non-Billable API Calls Over Time

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time,
  countIf(counts_against_api_limit = 1) AS "Counts Toward Limit",
  countIf(counts_against_api_limit = 0) AS "Does Not Count"
FROM salesforceProd.api_total_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  user_name AS "User",
  countIf(counts_against_api_limit = 1) AS "Billable Calls",
  count() AS "Total Calls",
  countIf(status_code >= 400) AS "Errors",
  round(100 * countIf(status_code >= 400) / count(), 1) AS "Error %",
  groupUniqArrayIf(5)(COALESCE(NULLIF(connected_app_name,''), NULLIF(connected_app_id,''), client_name), connected_app_id != '' OR client_name != '') AS "Apps Used"
FROM salesforceProd.api_total_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND user_name != ''
GROUP BY user_name
ORDER BY "Billable Calls" DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top Connected Apps — Billable API Calls

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(connected_app_name, ''), NULLIF(connected_app_id, ''), NULLIF(client_name, ''), '(platform / unnamed)') AS "Connected App",
  api_client_category AS "Category",
  countIf(counts_against_api_limit = 1) AS "Billable Calls",
  count() AS "Total Calls",
  countIf(status_code >= 400) AS "Errors",
  round(100 * countIf(status_code >= 400) / count(), 1) AS "Error %"
FROM salesforceProd.api_total_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY "Connected App", api_client_category
ORDER BY "Billable Calls" DESC
LIMIT 20
